description: React component for displaying detailed invoice information, including invoice items, status, payment history, and actions such as sending, downloading, editing, and recording payments.

classes.name: useStyles
classes.description: Hook for styling Material-UI components, including table and header container styles.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Determines the color status of the invoice based on total paid and invoice status.

methods.name: createAndDownloadPdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the invoice and triggers download.

methods.name: sendPdf
methods.description: Sends the invoice PDF via email through an API call.

methods.name: editInvoice
methods.description: Navigates to the invoice editing page.
